Corollary
↗ ex:euclidean-connection ↗ prop:tangential-covariant-derivative-projection 1. ch5:5.2

If $M\subseteq \mathbb R^n$ is an embedded submanifold, a smooth curve $\gamma :I o M$ is a geodesic for the tangential connection if and only if $\gamma ''(t)\perp T_{\gamma (t)}M$ for every $t\in I$.

Proof

\sketch The Euclidean connection has zero coefficients in the standard frame, so $\overline D_t\gamma '=\gamma ''$. Apply Proposition 2.

□

For pseudo-Euclidean space $(\mathbb R^{r,s},\overline g^{(r,s)})$ and an embedded nondegenerate submanifold $M$, write $T_p\mathbb R^{r,s}=T_pM\oplus N_pM$, where $N_pM=(T_pM)^\perp $, and let $\pi ^ op $ denote the corresponding orthogonal projection. The tangential connection is \[ abla _X^ op Y=\pi ^ op (\overline abla _{\widetilde X}\widetilde Y), \] for ambient extensions $\widetilde X,\widetilde Y$.
